explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 134 to 81 raw lines (39.6%) and from 9,847 to 6,149 characters (37.6%). It maps owners, input contracts, transitions and publication boundaries. Six peripherals give polling, pin stability, execution, experiment decisions, comparison evidence and output safeguards their primary explanatory locations. Workflow variants, numeric limits, retry mechanics and cleanup sequences have moved out of the overview. [M] means modular structure, including public/internal boundaries and dependencies; [C] means call flow; [O] means ownership/lifetime; [D] marks computational data dependencies, not another organizational layer.

The critique's adapter-scope issue is corrected: the entire execution expansion attaches to Run orchestration, while its adapter subtree owns only session behavior. Publication has a separate edge directly to the promotion node inside retain. Peripherals sit beside their relevant central branches, with no intervening diagram columns. Measured text bounds leave at least 24 columns on the left, 12 on the right, and four empty rows between stacked peripherals. All seven diagrams are connected; endpoints use 1-based raw lines. Schema, printable ASCII, endpoints and non-overlap were checked. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Corrections and qualifications from the pinned source: edited attempts rerun workflow stages rather than only the selected stage (evalRunService.ts:278-300, 441-443; experimentService.ts:188-219). Validation retries cover validator failures, not runtime exceptions (evalRunService.ts:654-668). The seed's late-response guarantee is scoped to usePolled cleanup, which does not abort its request (EvalsPage.tsx:71-97). Mixed terminal success becomes partial only after active cells are gone (evalRun.ts:94-99). Reconciled judgement run/cell links can be absent (judgementService.ts:31-35). Public method names are setArchived and deleteRun. Ordinary promotion requires a finished cell for a new request, whereas placement backfill requires a finished run; an existing matching receipt is returned before source revalidation (evalRunService.ts:122-175).

Additional source detail includes stage-only prompt hashing and merge ancestry (evalPromptService.ts:14, 131-164), omitted revision-parent boundaries in endpoint copies (compareSessionService.ts:32-42), runtime resource isolation and cache identity (agentContextEvalRuntime.ts:18-35), and exact planned-cell coverage plus exclusive experiment ownership of a judgement (experimentService.ts:58-99). These expand the seed without reproducing other points.

Evidence is restricted to the point definition and eight pinned source texts; the seed supplies the starting content. Previous output and critique were used only as review feedback. Textual point pointers use the supplied relationships: contexts, generation, canvas, changes and storage. The collection-wide suggestion to reconcile other points or link their diagram IDs cannot be substantiated from these inputs, so no such implementation claims or diagram targets are invented. Few-shot internals, base-session persistence and catalog publication atomicity remain outside the supplied implementations.

|   |-- Run launch and output inspection expose the same retained run evidence
|   |-- Experiments organize samples; judgements expose their recorded assessments
|   |-- Selected outputs feed the comparison launcher and its comparison views
|   `-- [O] Navigation, selection, dirty edits and polling belong to the interface
|       |-- Active jobs change refresh cadence; new outputs refresh catalog listings
|       `-- Polling guards protect local updates and stop updates after cleanup
|
|-- [M] Versioned inputs: EvalPromptService supplies the run's prompt contract
|   |-- Exposes version saving, forking, resolution, snapshots and setArchived
|   |-- Keeps write serialization and workflow/ancestry validation internal
|   |-- [D] A prepared run binds prompt versions to captured evaluation inputs
|   |   |-- Stage text, template base and cited reference text travel with the run
|   |   |-- Selected references and workflow-specific canvas/layout inputs are pinned
|   |   |-- AgentContext ID + recorded hash identify the required context evidence
|   |   `-- Canvas source + checkpoint resolve through CompareSessionService.capture
|   |-- [O] Later prompt or canvas edits do not rewrite already captured inputs
|   |   `-- Reruns reuse matching pins and remain associated with the original root
|   `-- Context library supplies resolved execution inputs [point: contexts]
|       `-- Hash verification rejects changed context before using its contents
|
|-- [M] Run orchestration: EvalRunService coordinates preparation and execution
|   |-- Exposes start, prepareForReview, launchPrepared, read, rename and cancel
|   |-- Keeps workflow chains, validation, live jobs and persistence ordering internal
|   |-- Depends on prompt/context resolution, comparison capture, store and runtime
|   |-- [C] start -> prepare inputs -> persist queued run -> execute workflow chains
|   |   `-- Ordinary cells identify a prompt version, sample pass and workflow stage
|   |-- [D] Workflow stages consume pinned inputs and any required preceding output
|   |-- [C] Runtime response -> workflow validation -> retained output or failed cell
|   |   `-- AgentContextEvalRuntime selects the execution adapter [point: generation]
|   |-- [O] Run owns progress and output provenance; runtime owns active sessions
|   |   `-- Status derives from cells; completed outputs survive other cell failures
|   `-- History-coordinated runs retain artifacts under an external recovery owner
|       `-- Local preparation rejects diagram-history; its coordinator launches it
|
|-- [M] ExperimentService organizes design, review and repeated attempts
|   |-- Public records expose phases, conditions, input cases, samples and attempts
|   |   `-- Stage output references connect experiment samples to run ID + cell key
|   |-- Internal prepared runs and launch receipts support resumable approval
|   |-- [D] Design must agree with project, context/hash, output cells and subjects
|   |-- [C] Save planned generation -> prepareForReview -> awaiting-approval review
|   |   `-- Approval launches the captured runs and attaches their stage outputs
|   |-- [O] Started plans and sample/input assignments are protected from rewriting
|   |-- [C] Edited attempt -> prompt fork -> workflow rerun -> next sample attempt
|   `-- Finished proposal evidence -> deterministic judgement -> comparison record

|-- [M] Comparison and assessment separate captured evidence from live sources

|   |   |-- Depends on saved workspace records, generated outputs and session storage
|   |   |-- [C] create(pairs) -> capture selected sources -> createPinned -> store
|   |   |-- [D] Panes require captured checkpoints and their rendering revisions
|   |   `-- [O] Each session owns independent endpoint copies [point: canvas]
|   |-- JudgementService exposes list/read/delete and typed evaluator-result saves
|   |   |-- [C] Reconcile comparison sessions/jobs into durable assessment records
|   |   |-- Native saves also retain few-shot progress and change-tree judgements
|   |   `-- [D] Subject references + captured evidence + evaluator metadata + result
|   `-- [O] Judgements own attachments and may assess outputs from several runs
|       `-- Run/cell provenance is included when the owning output can be identified
|
|-- [O] Retained outputs preserve evaluation evidence across later workspace edits
|   |-- Single canvas: generated catalog representation + run's checkpoint snapshot
|   |-- Multi-canvas result: full frozen documents in run + summary on output cell
|   |-- History result: timeline/step reference to shared checkpoint storage
|   |-- [D] Cell identity connects output evidence, usage and execution provenance
|   |-- [C] External proposal capture pins a change-session result [point: changes]

    |-- [D] New promotion requires a finished cell, destination and request signature

[O] Polling and local edit protection
|-- usePolled reuses one in-flight request
|   |-- Idle interval = 20 s; active result = 2.5 s
|   |-- Read local revision before awaiting load()
|   |   |-- Unchanged -> apply result
|   |   `-- Changed -> discard result; poll immediately
|   `-- Cleanup closes hook and clears timer
|       `-- Ignore late results/errors; request is not aborted
|-- Dirty prompt blocks replacement by polled prompt data
|   `-- beforeunload guards exit while dirty
`-- Completion counts drive dependent refreshes
    |-- Finished comparison count -> refresh sessions
    `-- Produced output count -> refresh generated catalog

[D] What makes an input pin stable
|-- Prompt writes require the current baseVersion
|   |-- Stage/template-base changes or explicit parents append a version
|   `-- Content hash covers sorted stage text only
|-- Parent traversal rejects cycles and cross-workflow ancestry
|   |-- Exception: diagram-history may derive from change proposals
|   `-- Merge lineage requires at least two parents
|-- resolve() freezes cited reference name, ASCII and comment
|   `-- Missing cited reference rejects resolution
|-- prepare() rejects missing/unknown bindings and duplicate sources
|   |-- Selected references require a references variable in each prompt
|   |-- Earlier alternatives must match workflow and AgentContext
|   `-- Alternatives layout input must match the prompt's file contract
|-- Execution reads resolvedSnapshot, falling back to snapshot
|   `-- Recorded context hash must match the saved context
`-- Ownership follows the original root run's AgentContext
    `-- Canvas-only workflows create a context describing their inputs

[C] Orchestration, workflow dependencies and session lifetime
|-- EvalRunService schedules prompt/sample chains
|   |-- Default = 3 workers per run; prepared session context = 1
|   `-- start request ID + hash -> reuse; conflicting hash -> reject
|-- generateValidated() composes prompt once
|   |-- Runtime response -> accumulate usage -> validate
|   |-- Validator failure -> previous output + error -> retry
|   |   `-- At most three responses; runtime exceptions escape this loop
|   `-- Proposal envelope checked; exact tree syntax retained for judging
|-- Workflow-specific computation
|   |-- Alternatives -> optional template -> materialized canvas
|   |-- Linked canvases -> captured canvas set -> frozen multi-canvas result
|   |-- Roll-up r2 consumes child + minimized/full parent
|   |   `-- g2 needs r2 output and parent history; r2 failure skips g2
|   `-- Few-shot -> executeFewShot; one prompt and three passes required
|       `-- Round algorithm is outside the pinned source
`-- AgentContextEvalRuntime selects adapter and owns session resources
    |-- No agentContext -> CodexEvalRuntime
    |-- With agentContext -> resolve messages before opening session
    |   |-- No tools, ambient context files, skills or extensions
    |   |-- Compaction/retry disabled; SSE transport
    |   `-- Cache key hashes provider/model/effort/system prompt/context
    |       `-- Independent session audit IDs remain unique
    |-- Prompt + supplementary files -> response; parse JSON if possible
    |   `-- Malformed JSON remains raw text for workflow validation
    `-- Abort/timeout requests abort; finally clears listener and timer
        `-- Unsubscribe, dispose session and remove it from runtime set

[C] Review and relaunch decisions
|-- save() maps every prepared cell exactly once to a planned output
|   |-- Project, case context and optional hash must agree
|   `-- Judgement subjects must fit comparison phase/cases/conditions
|       `-- A judgement cannot already belong to another experiment
|-- prepareForReview() captures inputs without starting a model job
|   `-- Experiment stores prepared runs; public record hides them
|-- approve(expectedRevision, requestId) persists receipt before launch
|   |-- launchPrepared() for each unstarted run
|   |-- Persist each started ID so repeated approval can resume
|   `-- Finish attaching output references; mark review started
|-- relaunch() selects a source stage for edited prompt ancestry
|   |-- Reserve next attempt within phase/case/condition/sample number
|   |-- Persist receipt -> launchEdited -> forkForAttempt
|   |   `-- Deterministic attempt ID reuses matching prompt forks
|   `-- Rerun all workflow stages: one ordinary pass, three for few-shot
|       `-- Remap matching source prompt/pass stages into the new sample
`-- judge() requires finished cells with exact proposalTree evidence
    |-- Also requires canvas/checkpoint IDs and run/cell references
    `-- Save deterministic result before attaching its judgement ID

[D] Endpoint capture and typed assessment evidence
|-- capture() deduplicates documentId + viewId + checkpointId
|   |-- Generated source may supply a retained requested checkpoint
|   `-- Workspace source must match current head or saved-view endpoint
|-- copyCompareHistory() creates a fresh history context
|   |-- Baseline = head = chosen checkpoint; past/future are empty
|   |-- Remove checkpoint parent and transaction IDs
|   `-- Retain required revisions and record omitted-parent boundaries
|-- createPinned() clones captures before assembling panes
|   |-- Diagram pane checks revision, line slice and subtree existence
|   `-- Canvas pane retains viewport and validates focus targets
|-- Judgement list/read reconciles sessions and jobs through a queue
|   |-- Resolve subjects by generated run ID, then canvas membership
|   |   `-- Run/cell links remain optional if ownership cannot be resolved
|   |-- Comparison records retain only captures used by their result pairs
|   `-- Finished job lacking session -> failed comparison record
|       `-- Experiment report instead retains the job's status
`-- Tombstones survive reconciliation
    |-- Missing legacy source tombstones its imported judgements
    |-- Delete active imported judgement -> delete comparison job
    `-- Restart fails active eval-run judgements; completed rounds remain

[O] Output capture, deletion and publication safeguards
|-- captureOutputResult() serializes result writes per run
|   |-- Same session/version already pinned -> return existing summary
|   |-- Reject other pinned result, canvas output or unavailable cell
|   |-- Reject live/deleted runs and cancelled/skipped cells
|   `-- Match project/session/version -> pin -> finish cell -> persist
|-- Local progress saves serialize snapshots; live state preserves rename
|   |-- Queued/generating cells keep run active
|   `-- Mixed success becomes partial only when no active cells remain
|-- Restart fails unfinished local cells and keeps completed outputs
|   `-- History coordinator is exempt from this startup recovery
|-- Deletion sets guard -> aborts local work -> drains saves
|   |-- Archive outputs -> persist run tombstone
|   `-- Late generated output is archived; guarded saves cannot revive run
|-- promoteOutput() checks existing request receipt before resolving output
|   |-- Matching signature returns receipt, even before cell revalidation
|   |-- New request needs finished cell; whole run need not be finished
|   `-- Existing target must be settled, non-generated and non-projection
|       `-- Revision match and clean workspace copy required
|-- publishOutputPromotion receives prepared documents and placement source
|   `-- Catalog implementation/atomicity is outside this evidence
`-- Placement backfill requires a finished run and original matching receipt
    |-- Whole-canvas promotion only; existing-canvas destination rejected
    `-- Backfill catalog lineage and add a missing pinned placement snapshot
